faqs.a:
The following words, terms and phrases, when used in this article, shall have the
               meanings ascribed to them in this section, except where the context clearly indicates
               a different meaning:
House
shall apply to and include any residence, apartment, store, office or other building
               used or capable of being used for residential, office or other business purposes and
               fronting on a street or avenue.
(Code 1960, § 21-12; Code 1981, § 30-101)
